core.title: Modern Glass Wall Mounted Tooth Brush Holder, Deltana BBN2014

text.description_html:
Deltana BBN2014, Wall Mounted Tooth Brush Holder With Glass

The modern appeal of the BBN Series tooth brush holder can be found both in the contemporary wall mount with concealed screws and in the 2 chic finishes in which it is available. The bracket and rose are available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes and the caddy is made of glass. It is made with the attention to quality Deltana is known for; and when mounted to the wall, this tooth brush holder will make an ultra fashionable--yet functional--accessory to any bathroom.

Shop more of the Deltana Nobe Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Nobe Modern Tooth Brush Caddy:

  • Material: Zinc wall mount (available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes) with a glass cup.
  • Overall Projection: 4"
  • Cup Height: 3-3/4"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Deltana BBN2014 Tooth Brush Holder with Glass Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 tooth brush holder, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
